scope: S3 case C4 (phase branch): stuck-open PZR relief to the first primary vapour birth. Lines frozen before any C4 run (RP1, P1); every probe value and margin comes from P-4, the full-unit C4 preview, and is open; revision 2, after C4's preview-2 result, re-declares N4 (owner R7-Q, CH-1, with the lead's terms S3-D58) and O4 (lead S3-D57), each logged re-declared after result (RP1); r1's red verdicts stay on record

commonRules.from: ld01-s3-cases-c1c3 revision 3.7 (RP1-pin-s3-c1c3-r3.7): common rules A to L of the S3 draft; the values the C4 harness reads are copied here verbatim
commonRules.eventClasses: S3-D4 rule (storage-rate-only held input S; else R)
commonRules.derivedTolerance: S3-D16: tightest credited budget the coordinate determines x |sensitivity|

kineticsDomain.ruleI: A4 (owner-approved, R5-A): a case runs to its declared end, or until D3 (a) ends it, labelled
kineticsDomain.floor: B1 (owner-approved, R5-B): HOT-SOURCE-1's pressure floor 8 MPa (reference-operating-source) with a per-core-region phase-absence check; a failing region ends the run, labelled

phaseBirth.rule: G1 (owner-approved, R5-G): vapour is born in a liquid-only cell at liquid superheat creditedMax_K, not at exact saturation
phaseBirth.disclosure: a declared nucleation-delay model, not a prediction of nucleation

frameAlignment.rule: every case starts on a frame instant; event times are stated relative to the case start, with their offset from the frame grid

openItems.F1: no Linux 6-8-core measurement host now (R5-F1): CPU results are provisional and S3 cannot formally exit

C4.ans: T10, stuck-open PZR relief (P10 acceptance suite), first phase only
C4.initialCondition: the S3 settled state of section 1.3: PZR pressure control in AUTO, the generator connected and exporting, the S3 tolerance classes

pzrRelief.what: the independent PZR relief fails open at t = 0: its mechanical demand is held open whatever PT1 reads; the lift travels toward it at the device's own rate and sticks at full lift (x = 1); no reseat demand and no closing motion until the end
pzrRelief.basis: pressure-and-inventory.md#independent-relief-candidate: finite travel toward the mechanical demand, never an instant full-open initialization; sticking constrains actual motion
pzrRelief.class: R (S3-D4: a change to the relief's demand and its root arming)

malfunctions.cmtIsolations: fail closed: CMT injection requests are recorded, no CMT flow (S3 composes CMT requests only, rule J)
malfunctions.prhrIsolation: fail closed: PRHR requests are recorded, no PRHR flow (rule J)

C4.operatorTurbineTripFrom: the first accepted reactor-trip cause (a division's trip), as C3 (S3-D39)
C4.operatorTurbineTripBasis: declared case input, the same as C2-M (S3-D22); LD-01 has no automatic reactor-trip to turbine-trip function (S4 item); the trip time is emergent, the delay declared

ends.rule: the run ends at the first of the following, labelled; any other stop is a failure
ends.subcooledVapour: first vapour in a subcooled cell (S3-D-P5), read under S3-D32 and S3-D37: vapour entering a liquid-mode cell condenses exactly into its totals and PZR vapour leaves through the surge port, both represented and recorded (M3); the end is the first vapour receipt the model refuses by name, at the last accepted step
ends.dryout: the first dryout: the kernel's named dryout refusal (mode G is S6 scope) at the last accepted step
ends.solidPzr: S3-D17 as amended: the stratified cell's named solid-PZR refusal (the solid-PZR structural limit) at the last accepted step before vapour-zone exhaustion; the submerged-inlet mode is S6's
ends.ruleI: rule I at every frame instant: A4's D3 (a) exit, B1's 8 MPa floor and B1's per-core-region phase-absence check as the wiki states it (lead S2-D42): vapour present in a core region's coolant ends the run, labelled

volumeClasses.rule: from the packet's prepared enthalpies: hot side = the regular cells prepared at the hot-leg cells' enthalpy, cold side = the regular cells prepared at the cold-leg cells' enthalpy; PZR and SURGE excluded; every other regular cell is in neither class
volumeClasses.check: the harness refuses unless the lists equal the rule applied to the run's packet (SPRAY has no prepared fluid region there and is in neither class)
volumeClasses.disclosure: r3's SG inlet halves (hot) and outlet halves (cold) are one SG primary cell per SG in the S3 packets, prepared at the cold-leg enthalpy, so each SG primary is cold side

O1.action: the PZR relief fails open: its travel stop at full lift is the first relief transaction after t = 0, at the end of its declared travel; no reseat demand and no closing motion before the end; relief mass flow positive at every frame instant from full lift to the end

O2.action: LD01.PROT.PZR.LOW_PRESSURE accepted in each powered division iff its voted acquired PT is at or below 13.00 MPa for 0.5 s (rule A′); the reactor trip: LD01.TRIP.HOLD lost at the first accepted reactor-trip cause; all 52 bodies seat before the end (S2's G9)
O2.window: protection consistency (rule A′), before the end
O2.marginRule: (13.00 MPa - the lowest voted PT before the end) / (PT1 at t = 0 - 13.00 MPa)

O3.action: with each division's LD01.PROT.PZR.LOW_PRESSURE acceptance, its CMT injection and PRHR requests recorded at that instant; no CMT or PRHR flow (isolations failed closed; requests only in S3, rule J)

O4.action: the first birth among the classified cells (hot or cold side; SURGE and PZR excluded, as the volume classes) is in a hot-side cell, as a located birth root with the phase-mode owner's birth transaction and its counted class-R restart, with L1 deciding every vapour path at that instant; the joined structure follows the new presence key whenever the born cell is one the pattern reads (S3-D-P3; a cell outside the read set needs no recompile, and its restart reports presence_changed false)
O4.expected: HOUSING.NECK, then HOUSING.MAIN (PHASE-P7 and PHASE-L1 network-only relief cases: reduced model, supporting only)
O4.marginRule: P-4 reports every core region's liquid departure from saturation (T_l - Tsat) at the first birth; the controlling setpoint is B1's phase absence (S2-D42: vapour in a core region), reached at that region's birth threshold (creditedMax_K, G1); the margin is the smallest core region's remaining distance to its birth threshold at the first birth over that distance at t = 0; below the setpoint-distance fraction the line becomes may occur (A″)

N1.action: a cold-side birth before the first hot-side birth

N2.marginRule: (15.50 MPa - the highest voted PT) / (15.50 MPa - PT1 at t = 0)

N3.action: an SG relief crack (either SG) before the operator turbine trip
N3.window: t = 0 to the operator turbine trip
N3.marginRule: (6.8 MPa - the highest SG pressure before the operator turbine trip) / (6.8 MPa - the SG pressure at t = 0), the lower SG

N4.action: numerical chattering: a vapour-path re-closing that follows neither a located exhaustion nor a located flow reversal, as the rule states; each is a DR-P1
N4.rule: No numerical chattering: every vapour-path re-closing must follow a located exhaustion or a located flow reversal — a consistent state before it, for a reversal a drive toward the emptying end beyond its tolerance, its cause recorded; such closings are counted and reported.
N4.ruleFrom: owner R7-Q (CH-1), 17 October 2026, re-declared after result (RP1)

terms.consistentState: every row's pre-transaction residual at most 1 integrator tolerance unit, rtol·|y| + atol (JACAGE's units) (S3-D58)
terms.driveBeyondTolerance: |drive| above the drive's first-order propagated tolerance, rule F's construction of a_x (S3-D58)

N4.judgesAlso: C3's rule-B direction 'no chattering' follows this line (S3-D45, owner R7-Q); the C1–C3 block is unchanged

M1.action: PZR high level from the flashing insurge: the acquired LT vote at or above 10.00 m for 0.5 s (ld01-pzr-level-protection highLevel_m; LD01.PROT.PZR.HIGH_LEVEL is not implemented in S3, S3-D21); the largest acquired LT is recorded

M2.action: every other implemented cause (LD01.PROT.TG.TRIP from the operator turbine trip, SG A/B LOW from the collapsed-volume proxy, the low-flow and unavailable causes), the section's recorded PZR low-level vote, the operator turbine trip's STOP ramp, generator breaker opening and bus transfer, SG relief openings after the operator turbine trip, and PZR heater and spray changes (AUTO control): recorded with their times

M3.action: vapour received by a liquid-mode cell and condensed there (S3-D32), PZR vapour leaving through the surge port (S3-D37), and every exhaustion and re-birth: recorded with times and cells

directions.direction: falls after the trip, then rises once the primary saturates

directions.parameter: birth cell's liquid departure from saturation

directions.direction: falls by exactly the integrated relief flow

gates.directions: rule B on the table above (S3GATES implements the family; a preview reports the values)
gates.conservation: rule D: mass and energy less the relief discharge; birth transactions pay only declared terms; L1 locks pay kinetic energy once
gates.refinement: rule E: a pair around the first birth (2.5 ms-capped reference and BDF2 at rtol/100 over its window); births compared as events (S3-D14); rule K's post-event spectrum 1 s after each phase-mode change
gates.cost: rule G: the run at most s3UnitRecurringIncludingEvents; S2's additional budgets over the intervals rule I leaves: each window with its recovery at most s2WindowAndRecovery, and s2TripAverage from the reactor trip to the end; reference: post-birth 0.32-0.43 CPU-s per simulated second on JAC's path, 0.47-0.53 at the time (PHASE-P7); provisional on macOS (R5-F1)
